name: FDA iCGM special controls (21 CFR 862.1355)
summary: Seven range-specific accuracy thresholds on the lower 95% confidence bound, e.g. overall within 20% for more than 87% of readings.

name: eCGM (Mathieu et al. 2024)
summary: Mirrors iCGM thresholds; about 100 adults, lab reference, meal and insulin challenges, at least 3 sensor lots, full trial disclosure.

name: IFCC WG-CGM guideline (Pleus et al. 2026)
summary: Study design, comparator requirements and minimum point-accuracy criteria.

name: IFCC comparator recommendations (2025)
summary: Comparator method, sample origin, and comparator bias and imprecision limits.

name: CLSI POCT05, 2nd edition
summary: Performance metrics for continuous interstitial glucose monitoring.

name: Pemberton et al. 2023
summary: Contrasts CE marking with FDA and TGA controls.

name: International clinical opinion on transparency (2026)
summary: Public trial data, calibration-alignment declaration, standard procedures.

name: DSN Forum UK CGM comparison chart
summary: Study-design score (0-5) for CGMs available in the UK.
